task.wrong: Not quite, no reward this time. Here is why:

0.q: ₹10,000 grows 10% a year. After 10 years it is about…
0.why: Growth earns growth, so time does the heavy lifting.

1.a0: Three companies in three different sectors
1.a1: Three companies in the same sector
1.a2: One big bet on the best company
1.why: Companies in the same sector often fall together. Spread across different risks.

2.q: A company has ₹30 lakh and loses ₹3 lakh a month. How long can it last?
2.why: Cash divided by the monthly loss is its runway: 30 ÷ 3 = 10 months.

3.q: The CEO sells shares every quarter while saying business is booming. What do you check?
3.why: Actions with their own money say more than words. Check the numbers.

4.q: A fee of 1% on every buy and sell. A buy-then-sell round trip costs about…
4.why: You pay once going in and once coming out.

5.q: A price falls 20% but customers, profit and cash are unchanged. A good first question is…
5.a0: Did the business change, or just the price?
5.a1: How fast can I sell everything?
5.a2: Which friend told me to buy?
5.why: A falling price is not a falling business. Check what actually changed.

6.q: Someone promises guaranteed 100% returns in 3 months. This is…
6.why: No real investment can guarantee returns. Walk away.

7.q: Money you will need next month should be…
7.a0: In safe cash you can reach quickly
7.why: Money needed soon should not ride on a price that can fall.
